# Complete Technical Dossier — Gaurav Singh

## Overview
Gaurav Singh is a Computer Engineer and Systems Builder based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. His work spans distributed computing, edge IoT telemetry, data engineering pipelines, full-stack application development, and open-source systems architecture.

## Primary Roles & Experience
- Systems Architect & Computer Engineer at Hypothetica.
- Designer of resilient telemetry pipelines, edge hardware firmware (ESP8266/MicroPython, Brocade/Aruba network topologies, SMPS noise filtering, circadian lighting), and high-throughput data processing engines.
- Focus on sustainable, energy-efficient compute and robust observability without external cloud bloat.

## Complete Skills & Tools Matrix
- Core Programming: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Bash, SQL, C++, Node.js
- Data Engineering & Analytics: Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, Apache Hadoop, PySpark, Pandas, NumPy, D3.js, Splunk, ETL Orchestration
- Operating Systems & Virtualization: Debian Linux, Ubuntu Server, Proxmox VE, Docker, Tailscale Mesh Networking
- Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis
- Observability: Umami Analytics, Custom Spooler Daemons, OpenTelemetry, Health check daemons
- Embedded & Edge: MicroPython, Wemos D1 Mini, ESP8266/ESP32, Hardware PWM, Sensor Telemetry (DS18B20, MQ-135, ADC debounce)

## Detailed Systems Portfolio
1. DubForge Studio
   - Architecture: Modern speech synthesis, vocal diarization, and emotion transfer pipeline designed for open-source multi-speaker audio dubbing.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/dubforge-studio
2. Magnite OS Launcher & Taskbar
   - Architecture: Modular Linux desktop panel with live system metric graphs, launcher integration, and configurable widget sidebars.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/Magnite-OS-Taskbar
3. Arjunpuri Civic Portal
   - Architecture: Local municipal problem resolver with live status tracking, geotagging, and citizen submission workflows.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/Arjunpuri
4. Twitter NLP Traffic Congestion Evaluation
   - Architecture: Distributed NLP sentiment parsing and traffic anomaly detection pipeline evaluating public sentiment during odd-even vehicle regulation.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/Analysis-and-Evaluation-of-Traffic-Congestion-using-Twitter
5. Bag of Convolutional Features (BoCF)
   - Architecture: Deep learning feature aggregation system extracting intermediate CNN activations for high-speed content-based image retrieval.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/Bag-of-Convolutional-Features
6. Bingo Tour & Travels Portal
   - Architecture: Commercial fleet scheduling and booking web platform supporting dynamic route reservation and booking confirmations.
   - Repository: https://github.com/Grv-Singh/bingotourandtravels
